description: Start a  survey quiz in ChatGPT. Host an async game with friends — invite your crew with a link, everyone answers five funny questions on their own time, and when the game finishes you get results, a reveal, and email. Or play solo vs the World: pick a question pack, score your answers, and climb the pack leaderboard. Answer in the widget or say your answers in chat.
